listing.title: My First Dinosaurs Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Dino Pages – T. rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Dino Eggs & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: the perfect first dinosaur book!

Little explorers meet friendly dinosaurs like T. rex, Triceratops and Stegosaurus, along with prehistoric friends that flew and swam, a dino egg, a nest and a smoking volcano. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • 22 friendly dinosaurs: T. rex, Baby T. rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Brontosaurus, Diplodocus, Ankylosaurus, Spinosaurus, Velociraptor, Parasaurolophus, Iguanodon, Allosaurus, Protoceratops, Styracosaurus, Pachycephalosaurus, Carnotaurus, Kentrosaurus, Maiasaura, Archaeopteryx and a baby dino hatching from its egg
  • Prehistoric friends that aren't dinosaurs: the flying Pteranodon, the swimming Plesiosaurus and the sail-backed Dimetrodon
  • Dino things: an egg, a nest, a footprint, a fossil, a volcano and a palm tree
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series. Also try My First Animals Coloring Book and My First Trucks Coloring Book.
